results.fact: crowds.peakTraffic 'Weekends in July-August' vs season Apr-Jun and seasonal_guidance July marginal / August risky
results.correct_value: Busiest on weekends from late April through June; traffic falls off from July
results.evidence: A route write-up gives the season as April, May and June and says that from July climbers meet crevasses and a major bergschrund near the summit. Dated first-hand trip reports cluster in the same window (28 Apr 2007, 15 May 2020, 25 May 2020, 24 May 2015, 13-14 May 2023), with only one July report found. That agrees with the row's season, best_season and seasonal_guidance and contradicts the July-August peak in CROWDS, so only peakTraffic changes.
